FireworkLauncher.label: firework launcher
FireworkLauncher.description: A one-use firework launcher for celebrations. Once ignited, the propelled fireworks would emit a burst of sparks and colorful displays in the sky, giving spectators a mood bonus.
LaunchFireworkDesc: Initiate a dazzling pyrotechnic display in the sky. Audiences will receive a positive mood boost.
TerribleFireworks.stages.terrible_firewo: The fireworks celebration was terrible! The equipment is misfired and the show looks disjointed and unsynchronized.
UnimpressiveFireworks.stages.boring_fire: The fireworks celebration was unimpressive. A limited number of fireworks are lacking in vibrant colors and special effects.
BeautifulFireworks.stages.beautiful_fire: The fireworks celebration was beautiful. A brilliant display of light and sound delights everyone.
UnforgettableFireworks.stages.unforgetta: The fireworks celebration was unforgettable! Every participant rejoiced at the mesmerizing and harmonious visual feast.
